findings.title: Temporal and factory-local destination screening permits sponsor-selected clone sinks
required_capabilities: Sponsor deliberately or mistakenly chooses the predictable address of a future clone as immutable sponsorRecipient before it is deployed/registered.
A later successful creation deploys that clone with another configured prize before the first prize release.
Foreign-factory variant additionally needs another deployment and an authorized sponsor/deployer/owner selecting or approving its clone.
sequence: Create A with sponsorRecipient set to future B; B is code-free and not in the registry.
Create B with token ID 2 and verify B equals the predicted address and is now registered.
Cancel empty A into Refunding and release A token ID 1 through unsafe transferFrom; ownerOf==B passes.
Complete B normally: it releases only configured token ID 2; unrelated token ID 1 stays at B, with no generic execution/rescue route.
findings.impact: An honest NFT selected by the sponsor is stranded and the literal no-inter-clone movement promise is violated. A now-known B also makes a sponsor quote release revert and preserve its immutable liability.
